sentiment.rationale: Full-year revenue guidance was raised by $2B at the midpoint to $63.0B-$63.5B, and non-GAAP EPS guidance was lifted to $23.23-$23.70, representing a material upward revision from the company's own prior guidance. Revenue grew 54% year over year and EPS surged to $7.02 from $1.18, but the guidance raise is the primary driver of the positive score. The 15% decline in US realized prices and a 27% increase in R&D expenses are noted headwinds, but the forward guidance raise is clear and meaningful, warranting a score above 0.15.

key_risks: US realized prices fell 15% in the quarter.
The CVS formulary switch created patient and physician disruption, though the Zepbound impact was called modest.
International obesity reimbursement remains thin, so uptake leans on out-of-pocket payers.
key_opportunities: Zepbound US prescriptions tripled year over year, taking 71% of new starts.
Positive Phase 3 results for orforglipron, with regulatory submissions planned by year end.
Lilly gained market share in the incretin analogs market for the fifth consecutive quarter.
